classification: robustness diagnostic of previously explored history; not untouched forward validation
data: Coinbase Exchange hourly candles, 2023-01-01 inclusive to 2026-10-10 exclusive; same source/timeframe as wide_coins and random_entry
rule: CAPIT Z=4 H=24, use existing signals function and nonoverlap selection
entry: close of h+1, exit close of h+25 (60-minute entry proxy, not registered30 or actual live timing)
screen: Exclude AVAX/BCH/LTC using already-known Oct11 quote snapshot; this is not a historical dynamic eligibility screen or proof of passing future measured-cost requirements
cost_formula: gross return minus twice cost_per_side, retained for parity with original historical study; additive proxy, not actual fee reconciliation
episode: Group successive global signal hours separated by at most72hours, fixed for full11 then apply same episode labels to subset
matched_control: One common integer-hour shift per episode, offsets within +-360hours; all required entry/exit closes finite; preserve all episode coin/time offsets; include zero shift and actual signals in control pool, no outcome-based exclusions
control_expectation: Enumerate all valid shifts, no Monte Carlo estimate of control mean
interval: 90% episode bootstrap on sums/counts, 10000 draws, seed1; report trade-weighted mean net and paired excess, leave-one-episode-out
cash: $100 fixed independent trade stakes, realized net dollars and peak concurrent open notional; no assumed reinvestment, borrowing or annualization of bootstrap returns
limits: Controls are matched mean-return diagnostics, not a runnable competing account because shifted episodes can overlap; historical costs and screen are proxies; whole episodes are not guaranteed statistically independent
prohibited: No threshold/hold/exit grid, chosen best-episode deletion, registration edits, bot edits, live orders or new workflow
matched_control_support: Construct valid common shifts on full11 once; screened8 uses same per-episode shift support and episode IDs.
bootstrap_empty_episodes: Both universes use fixed full11 episode list. Generate exactly10000 draws; count undefined zero-count draws and use only defined means for conditional quantiles. Never treat empty draws as zero returns. LOO enumerates full11 IDs including subset-empty episodes.
